title: SPIRou Input Catalogue global properties of 440 M dwarfs
what_was_studied: Target properties and predicted near-infrared velocity information for the planned survey
numerical_result: The catalogue used 440 M dwarfs and treated telluric-correction performance as not yet established under real SPIRou conditions
remaining_question: Predicted information and exposure simulations are not achieved stellar precision

title: SPIRou NIR velocimetry and spectropolarimetry at the CFHT
what_was_studied: Instrument architecture, APERO processing, laboratory stability and initial stellar sequences
numerical_result: Coverage is 0.95 to 2.50 micrometres at R 70000 plus or minus 3000; a 32-hour calibration test reached 0.07 m/s while mid-M stellar sequences were about 2 m/s over weeks
remaining_question: Calibration-channel stability, six-hour stellar scatter and multi-week sequence RMS must not be treated as one metric

title: Estimating fundamental parameters of nearby M dwarfs from SPIRou spectra
what_was_studied: Synthetic telluric modelling with separate water-vapour and bulk atmospheric shifts before stellar parameter extraction
numerical_result: The model fits water independently and scales methane carbon dioxide and oxygen with airmass using measured coefficients
remaining_question: Model adequacy for stellar RV at different weather states remains exposure dependent

title: SPIRou observations of the young planet-hosting star PDS 70
what_was_studied: Multi-season spectropolarimetry and line masks used to separate magnetic and activity-sensitive behaviour
numerical_result: Observations span seasons in 2020, 2022 and 2024 and include a roughly 300-line CO mask chosen for lower magnetic sensitivity
remaining_question: A result on one young active star does not define the general instrument floor

title: SPIRou observer cookbook
what_was_studied: Current observing modes, pipeline products and operational guidance
numerical_result: CFHT states that SPIRou has been offered since semester 2019A and the checked page was updated in November 2025
remaining_question: Availability does not mean every pipeline version or observing mode has identical precision
